_comments: Sales.CloseDeal — master plan §7.2. Named for the OUTCOME TYPE, not for 'won': the operation
resolves its entire path from the target DealStatusType's flags (IsWon / IsLost / LocksDeal),
so a deployment that calls its winning status 'Signed' needs no code change.
ONE TRANSACTION, all-or-none. A partial close — contract created, order missing — is exactly
the failure the transaction exists to prevent (§7.2).
GenerationType=Manual: CodeGen emits the typed shell, CloseDealOperation supplies the body.

Former description, corrected: closing runs in ONE transaction and resolves the effective CloseWonPolicy (pipeline default plus caller overrides). It does not route lines to an order: the deal's own order changes status when the deal enters a stage that names one (PipelineStage.OrderStatusOnEntry). Behaviour is decided by the policy and by DealStatusType FLAGS, never by a pipeline or status NAME. Sales passes intent only; every figure is computed by orders.

fields.Name: Close Deal
fields.Description: Closes a deal into the chosen status in one step. It checks the deal can close, records the stage change and close details, follows the pipeline's close-won policy (contract and follow-up tasks), and locks the deal when the status locks.

_comments: Sales.ReopenDeal — master plan §7.3. The ONLY sanctioned way out of the close lock.
Reason is required: a lock exists because the deal is now the provenance of a contract and an
order, so undoing it has to be explainable. The reopen is itself appended to DealStageEvent,
so the fact that a close happened survives the close being undone.

Former description, kept as the design note: Reopen a locked deal into a non-locking status, recording a mandatory reason. Appends a DealStageEvent, clears the close stamps, and releases the immutability enforced by DealEntityServer.Save(). The only sanctioned exit from the close lock (§7.3).

fields.Name: Reopen Deal
fields.Description: Reopens a locked deal into a status that does not lock, with a required reason. It records the stage change, clears the close details and unlocks the deal.

_comments: Sales.RecordDiscountConcession: records a deal line's raised discount as the Price concession orders'
confirm gate holds on.
SERVER-SIDE BECAUSE ORDERS FILLS THE CONCESSION THERE. Orders' table requires the order, the computed
value and the requesting user, and only orders' server subclass of the Order Concession entity sets them
(and decides whether the requester's Sales Authority covers it). Created in the browser, the generated
class ran instead, failed its own required-field validation and never reached the API, so no concession
was ever recorded and the rep saw a refusal with no reason.
WHAT ORDERS DECIDES. The concession is created as the calling user with the rep's reason category and
reason. Orders values it and decides it on save: Approved when the requester's Sales Authority covers it,
Pending for the approving role otherwise, or refused with orders' own reason (for example a tier conflict
or a line orders does not value). The operation returns whether it was recorded, whether it awaits
approval, and orders' message when it refuses. Sales states intent only; orders computes every figure.
GenerationType=Manual: CodeGen emits the typed shell, RecordDiscountConcessionOperation supplies the body.

fields.Name: Record Discount Concession
fields.Description: Records a deal line's raised discount as a Price concession on its order line, replacing the line's earlier one, for orders to value and decide.
